mapper.select: SELECT SUM(ke.final_amount) AS settled_amount, MAX(latest.processed_at) AS completed_at FROM settlement_item latest INNER JOIN krw_exchange ke ON ke.exchange_id = latest.exchange_id WHERE latest.batch_id = #{batchId} AND ke.account_id = #{accountId} AND latest.result = 'SUCCESS' AND ke.settlement_status = 'FINALIZED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item newer WHERE newer.batch_id = latest.batch_id AND newer.exchange_id = latest.exchange_id AND newer.item_id > latest.item_id )

SELECT c.email, COALESCE((SELECT agreed FROM customer_consent WHERE customer_id = c.customer_id AND consent_type = 'NOTIFY_PUSH' ORDER BY changed_at DESC, customer_consent_id DESC LIMIT 1), 1) AS push_enabled, COALESCE((SELECT agreed FROM customer_consent WHERE customer_id = c.customer_id AND consent_type = 'NOTIFY_EMAIL' ORDER BY changed_at DESC, customer_consent_id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS email_enabled, COALESCE((SELECT agreed FROM customer_consent WHERE customer_id = c.customer_id AND consent_type = #{consentType} ORDER BY changed_at DESC, customer_consent_id DESC LIMIT 1), 1) AS kind_enabled FROM customer c WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId}
